name: control-panel
title: Demo Apps Control Panel
description: Local operator UI that builds, starts, stops, resets and monitors the 20 demo apps through Docker Compose, streaming job output live.

env.name: HOST
env.description: Bind address; only expose beyond localhost together with PANEL_TOKEN

env.name: PANEL_TOKEN
env.description: Shared secret required on every /api call when set (header x-panel-token or ?token=)

env.name: DEMO_APPS_ROOT
env.description: Folder containing the NN-* app folders

env.name: PUBLIC_HOST
env.description: Host name used in the Open links

auth.description: No login. Optional shared token via PANEL_TOKEN. Bind to 127.0.0.1 by default because the panel executes docker commands.

persistence: none (jobs are kept in memory; app data lives in the apps' own Docker volumes)
notes: Operator tool, not one of the demo apps. Needs the docker CLI with the compose plugin and access to the Docker daemon. Compose-native apps (08-11, 15) are run from their own folder with the default project name so their setup scripts keep working; Dockerfile apps use the generated files in stacks/. Setup scripts need bash, curl and python3 on the machine running the panel.
